blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several parts of the country will experience rains and thunderstorms on Tuesday due to the easterlies and the northeasterly windflow, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 p.m. forecast on Monday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, Aurora and Quezon would have cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms due to the easterlies. Pagasa warned that moderate to, at times, heavy rains could trigger flash floods or landslides in these areas.
